opening.argument: The video demonstrates an account-linking feature in Citi Mobile: an Accounts Summary screen offers a way to link external accounts, and the description identifies bank, credit-card, and investment accounts as the accounts that can be added. The sequence is presented as an operational demonstration, not a solicitation for money or participation. The account-selection screen expressly identifies its image and user experience as simulated. Although later screens show credential-entry fields and an account summary, the available evidence does not establish that credentials were submitted or accepted, that an account was accessed, or that any financial loss occurred.

citations.quote: Simply add your Citi:registered: and non-Citi bank, credit card and investment accounts to the app for more control of your money.
